dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped markings exhibit sharp gradient transitions from dark charcoal perimeters to lighter tan interiors, with jagged geometric edges particularly prominent in the mid-lateral zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity, solid-colored pixels are densely packed in the anterior dorsal region, forming a near-contiguous mosaic of small, low-gradient spots.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-body annuli form an obtuse triangle, while a sequence of four smaller rings towards the posterior forms a linear chain.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of five distinct, parallel linear striations (diagonal rake-like markings) are visible on the upper-left dorsal quadrant.
